source: Approved Library design contracts (public generic layout only)

shell.breadcrumbRule: show validated hierarchy; active story pin must survive navigation
shell.statusRule: state as text plus a symbol, never color alone; Unknown is not success

HOME.heading: What will you create today?
HOME.continueCreating: only verified current story; otherwise empty/no source

STORYBOARD.heading: Storyboard
STORYBOARD.subtitle: Choose how to tell your story.

paths.title: REEL
paths.description: Turn an idea or screenplay into a visual story and movie.

paths.title: ONCE
paths.description: Tell a life story, bring memories to life and preserve them for family.

STORYBOARD.yourStories: actual authorized stories only; revision/location/verification visible

STORY_MAP.heading: Story Map
STORY_MAP.selection: read-only: switching Act changes subordinate view only; does not change story source

IMAGE_REVIEW.heading: Image Review
IMAGE_REVIEW.candidateChoice: show actual provenance, dimensions, hash, original/concept distinctions

REEL_WORKSPACE_ENTRY.heading: REEL
REEL_WORKSPACE_ENTRY.subtitle: From screenplay to screen.
REEL_WORKSPACE_ENTRY.approvedAs: Nested REEL entry workspace, not another primary HOME tile or top-level approval unit

startingOptions.title: New Idea
startingOptions.description: Develop a concept into a screenplay

REEL_WORKSPACE_ENTRY.yourStories: Only stories verified from accessible, authorized saved sources; show revision/location and unverified media caveat. Never embed example user project names, revision numbers or IDs.
exclusions: actual writer mutations or provider charges

MOBILE_STORYBOARD_REVIEW.heading: Mobile Storyboard Review
MOBILE_STORYBOARD_REVIEW.approvedAs: Responsive nested treatment of approved Grid and Image Review, not a hosted sidebar or new separately approved surface
order: story title, verified source identity and canonical address
summary counts with truth labels (planned positions, real byte-verified images, actual locked positions)
selected-shot detail with full real image when bytes accessible
horizontal/swipeable evidence tabs: Script, Beat, Prompt, Image, Continuity, Save/Lock
four independently labelled states: Human Approved / PPF Saved / PPF Locked / Media Verified
inactive production controls unless verified write tools available
graphic-novel reading link: five-page edition of corresponding Mini-Block
MOBILE_STORYBOARD_REVIEW.actionState: Disabled unless a real tool-backed guarded PPF operation and readback can execute; previews never mutate status
MOBILE_STORYBOARD_REVIEW.realImagePolicy: Render exact source-selected candidate only when verified bytes accessible; otherwise honest placeholder
MOBILE_STORYBOARD_REVIEW.responsive: Stack navigation/header/counts/shot-grid/inspector/image/status/action pane vertically on phones; desktop may group in columns
MOBILE_STORYBOARD_REVIEW.legacyReference: Creator-approved historical three-column dark sidebar screenshot saved privately in Design Library; reference only
MOBILE_STORYBOARD_REVIEW.graphicNovelLink: Offer existing verified five-page reading edition when authorized; never invent completed pages

graphicNovelReadingFormat.title: Five-panel mini-block edition
graphicNovelReadingFormat.narrativeAuthority: Latest authorized screenplay and shot mapping; not technical preview screenshot
graphicNovelReadingFormat.artDirection: Use creator-supplied/approved reference style and character/world continuity as guidance; do not copy specific protected film characters; do not substitute unrelated art
graphicNovelReadingFormat.releaseBehavior: Render/link verified existing reader pages from authorized Library; generate new panels only on creator request and with real output; no background batch process
graphicNovelReadingFormat.writeBehavior: Keep graphic novel sidecar separate from canonical PPF until explicit verified import; never automatically save, lock or overwrite original images
graphicNovelReadingFormat.privacy: Never bundle an individual creator’s story images, text or media in plugin
